sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Bunny Stack Jump is a simple game: you control the bunny as he jumps up and down a series of blocks, collecting power-ups and avoiding obstacles along the way. However, beneath its simplicity lies a game that's full of depth and strategy. As you progress through the levels, the game introduces new challenges and obstacles that require you to think creatively and use your skills to overcome them.

One of the key mechanics in Bunny Stack Jump is the use of blocks to propel the bunny upwards. By tapping on the blocks, you can create a trajectory that will send the bunny soaring through the air, collecting power-ups and avoiding obstacles along the way. However, be careful not to get stuck on a block for too long – if you do, the game will come to an abrupt end.

The game also features a range of power-ups that can be collected to give you an edge over your opponents. These power-ups come in various forms, from speed boosts to shields that protect you from obstacles. With these power-ups, you'll be able to tackle even the toughest levels with confidence.

In addition to the core gameplay mechanics, Bunny Stack Jump also features a range of special blocks that can be used to create complex and challenging levels. These blocks come in various forms, from blocks that create multiple trajectories to blocks that create obstacles. With these special blocks, you'll be able to create levels that are truly unique and challenging.
